pull_provenance.query: SELECT g.measurement_id, g.oid, g.mjd, g.ra, g.dec, g.band FROM alerce_tap.detection g WHERE g.sid=2 AND g.mjd >= 61206.000000 AND g.mjd < 61236.000000 AND g.ra >= 330.0 AND g.ra < 337.5 AND g.dec >= -20.0 AND g.dec < -15.0

SELECT g.measurement_id, g.oid, g.mjd, g.ra, g.dec, g.band FROM alerce_tap.detection g WHERE g.sid=1 AND g.mjd >= 61206.000000 AND g.mjd < 61236.000000 AND g.ra >= 330.0 AND g.ra < 337.5 AND g.dec >= -20.0 AND g.dec < -15.0
SELECT g.oid, g.ndiasources, g.firstdiasourcemjdtai, g.lastdiasourcemjdtai FROM alerce_tap.lsst_dia_object g WHERE g.ra >= 329.95 AND g.ra < 337.55 AND g.dec >= -20.05 AND g.dec < -14.95
